tasks.title_ar: تثبيت مسار حضور كامل قابل للتشغيل
acceptance_cases: Preserve previous result on a malformed file

tasks.title_ar: تجربة منفذ اقتصادي على تحسين محدود غير حساس
write_paths: documentation or one low-risk presentation improvement only
acceptance_cases: No change to ingestion, business keys, or acceptance totals

tasks.title_ar: تحديد وتنفيذ مدخل ملفات الموارد البشرية المتعددة
write_paths: TEST_HR_FOUNDATION.py or a new INT-01 test file
acceptance_cases: Upload attendance, employee, roster and leave sources without accidental overwrite
Missing one of the four sources is visible in result state, not a silent skip
Unknown employee id in attendance, roster or leave is a visible warning, not a rejection of the whole file
Update correction retains history and does not affect later records
Non-participating employee in a partial update is not treated as deleted
tasks.blocking_reason: The engine now accepts attendance plus optional employee/roster/leave files uploaded together; all four INT-01 acceptance cases are tested and pass. Employee is joined onto attendance (1:1 by employee_id). Roster/leave are read and validated independently but not yet linked by employee + work date; that is the next sub-stage (PROGRAM_MAP.md step 2), not started. No dashboard.html upload UI for multiple files was built.

tasks.title_ar: ربط الحضور بالوردية حسب الموظف وتاريخ العمل، وربط الإجازة الفعلي
acceptance_cases: Attendance row's roster_shift_id and roster_status are filled correctly when a matching (employee_id, work_date) roster row exists
No roster match for a given (employee_id, work_date) leaves those fields blank, not a rejection
A leave request overlapping a work_date is visible on the matching attendance row without duplicating attendance rows when an employee has more than one leave request
Existing INT-01 and foundation acceptance tests still pass unchanged
tasks.blocking_reason: Roster is now linked to attendance by a composite key (employee_id + work_date); leave is linked by date-range matching against approved, non-cancelled requests, with a deterministic tie-break so an employee with multiple leave requests never produces duplicate attendance rows. All five acceptance cases (roster match, roster no-match, leave overlap, multi-request no-duplication, and cancelled/pending exclusion) are tested and pass, alongside the unchanged foundation and INT-01 tests. Still open: no dashboard.html upload UI for multiple files; whether production truly splits leave into its own file is unconfirmed.

tasks.title_ar: بناء واجهة رفع الأربع ملفات معًا في dashboard.html
acceptance_cases: A real browser can select four files and upload them together through the dashboard UI, not just through a direct Python call
The old single-file upload control keeps working unchanged
A missing auxiliary source and an unknown-employee warning are both visible on screen after a multi-file upload
An unsupported file extension is rejected with a clear message from the same UI flow
tasks.blocking_reason: A new /api/upload_multi endpoint (multipart/form-data, stdlib email parser only, no new runtime dependency) and a new 'Upload HR files together' panel in dashboard.html let a user pick attendance plus optional employee/roster/leave files and upload them together with one click. Verified end to end in a real Chromium browser via Playwright (screenshots taken) and with a standard-library-only HTTP test. The old single-file upload path is unchanged and still tested green. Still open: Windows validation, a real (non-synthetic) daily file sample, and whether production truly splits leave into its own file.

rules: Task evidence applies only to its recorded project revision and contract version.
A builder does not change tests or protected paths to close a task without returning it to the foundation or integration role.
A blocked business-input decision is recorded rather than guessed.
